name: Trip Details Updated
description: Sent to every registered participant when a trip's details are changed
subject: Details have changed for {trip_name}
body_html:
Trip Details Updated

Dear {participant_name},

The details of a trip you are registered for have been updated.

Trip

Trip{trip_name}
Destination{destination}
Dates{trip_dates}
Status{trip_status}

What changed

{changes}

Your place on the trip is unaffected.

If you have any questions, contact the trips office.

{signature}

trip_dates.description: Trip dates, already formatted (a single date for single-day trips)

changes.description: One line per changed field, e.g. 'Destination: York -> Durham'

separator.description: Visual separator for the text version

signature.description: Email signature; supplied by the renderer when omitted
